summary: AIFU Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the immediate resignation of CFO Huaguang Huang for personal reasons, unrelated to company disagreements. The board appointed Shanyu Chang, a 14-year company veteran and US GAAP Senior Specialist, as his replacement effective the same date. The filing includes her extensive financial and audit background and confirms no conflicts or family ties. The change appears orderly, not forced. Watch for any further management turnover or operational impact, though this is routine in nature.
